checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Recognizable F-35 configuration (one exhaust, two canted tails, no canards)
must.why: Jet looks like a generic F-14/F-16 hybrid with a two-seat canopy and long swept wings. Tails are near-vertical. The overall shape is not an F-35.

must.item: Takeoff shows forward runway roll and lift-off
must.why: All frames show cruising above clouds. There is no runway or takeoff.

must.item: Same aircraft design consistent between runway and airborne views
must.why: There are no runway views. The airborne design changes slightly between frames: the second tail disappears and the wing shape shifts.

must.item: All three requested labels appear exactly and legible
Audible English narration correctly describes one engine and conventional takeoff without F-35B hover claims
must.why: The script as stated by the assistant says 'Lightning Two' and mentions no engine count or takeoff. The audio cannot be heard, but the stated script does not meet this.

faults.what: The jet is not an accurate F-35. It has a two-seat canopy and F-14/F-16-style wings and tails.
No runway takeoff scene. The whole clip is cruising above clouds.
The aircraft shape changes between frames: the second tail disappears and the wing planform varies.
The narration was not checked by the agent, and the script does not cover the engine count or the takeoff.

summary: The clip is a cinematic sunset flight of a generic fighter jet that does not look like an F-35. It has no runway takeoff and none of the three required labels.
